title: Allegation of assault at a 2023 function
allegationSummary: A woman publicly alleged, in an on-record interview reported by two national outlets on 3 and 4 March 2026, that Mr Castellan assaulted her at a function in 2023. She reported the matter to police on 4 March 2026. Police confirmed on 6 March 2026 that an investigation was under way. No charges have been laid.

statusHistory.note: Allegation published by an established outlet on the record.
Police confirmed an investigation. No charges laid.

title: Complaint alleging a push at a 2022 campaign event
allegationSummary: A man publicly alleged in June 2025 that Senator Fenwick pushed him at a campaign event in 2022, and reported the matter to police on 18 June 2025. Police investigated and announced on 14 October 2025 that no charges would be laid and the investigation was closed.

statusHistory.note: Allegation published by an established outlet.
Police announced no charges would be laid; investigation closed.

outcome: No charges laid. Police closed the investigation on 14 October 2025 without charge. No finding of guilt was made.

title: Allegation by former senator Brian Burston of sexual harassment (2019)

statusHistory.note: Allegation reported by established news organisations; denied the same day.

allegationSummary: On 14 February 2019 former One Nation senator Brian Burston publicly alleged, in comments reported by The Daily Telegraph and ABC News, that in 1998 Senator Hanson had rubbed her fingers up his spine and that she had propositioned him after his 2016 election. Senator Hanson denied the allegations and described them as retaliation. The allegation was later aired in evidence in defamation proceedings between the two; the court's findings in that case concerned Senator Hanson's statements about Mr Burston, not this allegation. PUBLIC RECORD has located no police report, investigation or finding relating to it.
